name: NanoGPT PRO

price.note: Can also be paid from your NanoGPT balance.

meters.label: Weekly input tokens
meters.hint: 60M input tokens. Usage & billing page, or GET /api/subscription/v1/usage

stipulations: Only input tokens count. Output on included models is free.
Only included open-weight text models draw from it. Closed models are billed from your balance instead.
Some models count input at a multiple (a 2x model counts each token twice). The docs don't say clearly whether this applies to the subscription allowance.
It is a soft limit. Requests already running can go past it.
Rate limits apply on top: 16 concurrent requests and 60 requests per minute.

meters.label: Daily images
meters.hint: 100 images. Usage & billing page, or the usage API

reset.rule: A daily allowance of 100 images. The pricing page doesn't say when it resets, but the usage API reports the exact reset time.
stipulations: Covers 4 image models only. Other image models, video and voice are billed from your balance.

overage: With a subscription-only key, requests stop at the limit until Monday. If you turn on "Overflow to pay-as-you-go" in subscription settings, extra requests are billed from your balance at normal prices instead of failing. Closed models, video, voice, transcription, web search and paid tools always bill from your balance.

how: 60M input tokens a week on included open-weight text models. Output is free.
100 images a day on 4 image models.
5% off eligible paid text models billed from your balance.
ext: Included models are all from other companies: GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, MiMo, Qwen and more. The full list is at nano-gpt.com/models/text?scope=subscription.
Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok are available but billed from your balance at list price, not from the plan.
Claude Code: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://nano-gpt.com/api/v1. OpenCode and other OpenAI-compatible tools use the same base URL. Both have official guides.
quirks: Picking a closed model in Claude Code or OpenCode silently bills your balance instead of the plan.
The documented usage API GET /api/subscription/v1/usage reports weekly input tokens and daily images with percent used and reset time. A usage-only token is available for it.
The weekly cap was added on 17 Feb 2026 and the price rose from $8 to $12 on 12 May 2026 (third-party report, unconfirmed).
